Definition: Ish-Bosheth, a son of King Saul
BiblicalUsage: Ish-bosheth was the son of Saul whom Abner made king over Israel, and his reign was short and bloody. In 2 Samuel 2:8 Abner takes Ish-bosheth and makes him king over Gilead, in 2 Samuel 3:8 Abner is wroth because Ish-bosheth accuses him of going in to Rizpah, and in 2 Samuel 4:5 two captains come to his house at noon and slay him on his bed.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Ish-bosheth is the warning against a throne held by another man's strength: Abner made him king, Abner left him, and two murderers finished him at noon.
